  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL

  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

  BUSINESS CENTER OF CROWNE PLAZA PALO ALTO
  4290 EL CAMINO REAL
  PALO ALTO, CA 94306

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

AGENDA – MAY 13, 2026  PAGE 1 of 5
 How to offer public comment from home:
Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m.
the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be
distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will
be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council at the meeting.

Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-person
comments. Written Zoom comments will be read or summarized, then printed and made
part of the public record for the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice
Mayor Lo, Mayor Chou

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
https://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION R-26-09 AUTHORIZING THE COLLECTION
  OF SEWER SERVICE CHARGES ON THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  PROPERTY TAX ROLL FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027

  Recommendation: Staff recommend the approval of Resolution No. R-26-09,
  Establishing Sewer Service Charge Amounts, and authorizing the collection of
  the Sewer Service charges on the Los Angeles County Property Tax Roll for
  Fiscal Year 2026-27. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation,
  an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution No. R-26-09, Establishing Sewer Service
  Charge Amounts, and authorizing the collection of the Sewer Service charges
  on the Los Angeles County Property Tax Roll for Fiscal Year 2026-27.”

  CONTINUED BUSINESS

 2.  REPORT ON EMERGENCY ACTIONS TAKEN TO REPAIR/REMEDIATE
  FIRE STATION 91 AND REQUEST TO EXTEND EMERGENCY
  PROCUREMENT PURSUANT TO PUBLIC CONTRACTS CODE SECTION
  22050 AND SAN MARINO MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 2.06.05(A)(8)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive the report of
  repair/remediation actions undertaken to date and extend the emergency by
  a 4/5 vote to facilitate expeditious restoration of Fire Station 91. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  "I move to receive and file the report of repair/remediation actions
  undertaken to date and to extend the emergency action approved in
  Resolution No. R-26-08 to facilitate the expeditious restoration of Fire Station
  91."

AGENDA – MAY 13, 2026  PAGE 3 of 5
   CONSENT CALENDAR

 3.  ACCEPTING CALIFORNIA OFFICE OF EMERGENCY SERVICES 911
  AWARD MONEY FOR THE PURPOSES OF UPGRADING THE CURRENT
  SAN MARINO POLICE DEPARTMENT PUBLIC SAFETY ANSWERING
  EQUIPMENT FOR $365,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council accept the $365,000.00
  award from the California Office of Emergency Services (CAL-OES) for the
  purposes of upgrading the current San Marino Police Department call handling
  equipment and authorize the City Manager to execute any documents
  required to receive the equipment contemplated by the grant. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to accept the California Office of Emergency Services 911 funds for
  the purpose of upgrading the current San Marino Police Department Public
  Safety Answering Equipment, in the amount of $365,000; and authorize the
  City Manager to execute any documents required to receive the equipment
  contemplated by the grant.”

 4.  APPROVAL OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH
  SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR MEASURE B ADVISORY BOARD FUNDING
  GRANT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council 1) authorize the City
  Manager to accept the 2025 Measure B grant funds and execute the
  agreement with the County of Los Angeles Department of Health Services for
  a performance period of May 14, 2026 to June 30, 2027; 2) approve budget
  amendments needed; and 3) dispense with competitive bidding requirements
  pursuant to SMMC §02.06.05 B. 2 b and authorize the Fire Department to
  purchase (2) Zoll X-Series Cardiac Monitors and (1) AutoPulse NXT
  Resuscitation Device from Zoll Medical Corporation in the amount of
  $156,656.13 and (1) Stryker Power Pro 2 Ambulance Cot from Stryker Sales,
  LLC in the amount of $45,843.95. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to authorize the City Manager to accept the 2025 Measure B grant
  funds and 1) execute the agreement with the County of Los Angeles
  Department of Health Services for a performance period of May 14, 2026 to
  June 30, 2027; 2) approve budget amendments required; and 3) dispense
  with competitive bidding requirements pursuant to SMMC §02.06.05 B. 2 b
  and authorize the Fire Department to purchase (2) Zoll X-Series Cardiac
  Monitors and (1) AutoPulse NXT Resuscitation Device from Zoll Medical
  Corporation in the amount of $156,656.13 and (1) Stryker Power Pro 2

   Ambulance Cot from Stryker Sales, LLC in the amount of $45,843.95.”

 5.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR APRIL
  2026

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of April 2026. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month
  of April 2026.”

 6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the April 2026
  Minutes. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of April 8, 2026, the
  Regular Meeting of April 8, 2026, the Adjourned Regular Meeting of April 24,
  2026, and the Special Meeting of April 24, 2026.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
